vetSays.line: 🛡️ Hermann, Diego, Joaquín, Xiaowen and Desmond met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Hermann, Diego, Joaquín, Xiaowen, Desmond are hurt.
🛡️ Hermann, Gilberto, Joaquín and Rafael met them at the door — 4 put down. Hermann, Gilberto, Joaquín, Rafael are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Gilberto, Joaquín, Nora and Nadia met them at the door — 4 put down. Gilberto, Joaquín, Nora, Nadia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gilberto just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gilberto, Joaquín, Xiaowen, Rafael and Desmond met them at the door — 5 put down. Gilberto, Joaquín, Xiaowen, Rafael, Desmond are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Xiaowen just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Leo met them at the door — 1 put down. Leo is hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Leo taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Leo drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
📓 Codex: A person, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm — jotted down what they said. Filed.
🛡️ Tadros, Mateo and James met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Tadros didn't come back. Mateo, James are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Big-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Big-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Big-Eyes!

Gilberto explains, very reasonably, why the OTHER one is the problem. The Pack-leader The Big Thing and The Big Thing (packmate) turn on each other. (Turncoat)
The Big Thing (packmate) glares at The Pack-leader The Big Thing — YOUR argument made sense! It lays into its fellow monster! (Turncoat: 15)
